title: Journal
subtitle: Every manual posting to the general ledger.

create.title: New journal entry
create.subtitle: Lines are saved as a draft; posting freezes the entry and moves the ledger.

validation.minLines: An entry needs at least two lines

balance.multiCurrencyNote: Multiple currencies — the server checks the balance in the base currency after applying exchange rates.

postConfirm.title: Post this entry?
postConfirm.body: Posting assigns its number and makes it part of the ledger. It can't be edited afterwards — only reversed.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this draft?
deleteConfirm.body: This draft entry will be removed. This can't be undone.

reverse.title: Reverse this entry
reverse.body: Creates a new posted entry with the sides swapped, so the two net to zero. The base amounts are copied from the original.
reverse.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Posted to the wrong period

detail.baseNote: Totals are in the base currency ({{currency}}).

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.permissionDeniedSection: You don't have permission to view this.
errors.unbalanced: Debits must equal credits in the base currency.
errors.empty: An entry needs at least two lines.
errors.accountNotFound: One of the selected accounts no longer exists.
errors.accountInactive: One of the selected accounts is inactive.
errors.controlNeedsPartner: A control account (receivables/payables) line needs a partner.
errors.currencyMismatch: A line's currency isn't allowed on that account.
errors.rateRequired: No exchange rate on that date — enter an explicit rate on the foreign-currency line.
errors.currencyNotFound: One of the selected currencies isn't recognised.
errors.partnerNotFound: One of the selected partners no longer exists.
errors.notDraft: Only a draft entry can be edited.
errors.notPosted: Only a posted entry can be reversed.
errors.alreadyReversed: This entry has already been reversed.
